                  "data": "const router = require('express').Router();\nconst db = require('../config/db');\nconst auth = require('../middleware/auth');\n\nrouter.use(auth);\n\nrouter.get('/nearby', async (req, res) => {\n  const { lat, lng, radius_m = 1000, category } = req.query;\n  if (!lat || !lng) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'lat and lng required' });\n\n  let q = `SELECT a.*, ST_Distance(a.location, ST_MakePoint($2, $1)::geography) AS distance_m,\n            json_build_object('username', u.username, 'reputation_score', u.reputation_score) AS author\n            FROM alerts a JOIN users u ON a.author_id = u.id\n            WHERE a.status = 'active' AND a.expires_at > NOW()\n            AND ST_DWithin(a.location, ST_MakePoint($2, $1)::geography, $3)`;\n  const params = [lat, lng, radius_m];\n\n  if (category) {\n    params.push(category);\n    q += ` AND a.category = $${params.length}`;\n  }\n  q += ` ORDER BY distance_m`;\n\n  const { rows } = await db.query(q, params);\n  res.json({ alerts: rows });\n});\n\nrouter.get('/:id', async (req, res) => {\n  const { rows } = await db.query(\n    `SELECT a.*, json_build_object('username', u.username, 'reputation_score', u.reputation_score) AS author\n     FROM alerts a JOIN users u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.id = $1`,\n    [req.params.id]\n  );\n  if (!rows[0]) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not found' });\n  res.json(rows[0]);\n});\n\nrouter.post('/', async (req, res) => {\n  const { category, title, description, lat, lng, radius_m = 100, duration_hours = 3 } = req.body;\n  const expires = new Date(Date.now() + duration_hours * 3600000).toISOString();\n  const { rows } = await db.query(\n    `INSERT INTO alerts (author_id, category, title, description, location, radius_m, expires_at)\n     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, ST_MakePoint($6, $5)::geography, $7, $8)\n     RETURNING *`,\n    [req.user.id, category, title, description, lat, lng, radius_m, expires]\n  );\n  req.app.get('io')?.emit('alert:new', rows[0]);\n  res.status(201).json(rows[0]);\n});\n\nrouter.delete('/:id', async (req, res) => {\n  const { rowCount } = await db.query(\n    `UPDATE alerts SET status = 'removed' WHERE id = $1 AND author_id = $2`,\n    [req.params.id, req.user.id]\n  );\n  if (!rowCount) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Not found or not owner' });\n  res.json({ ok: true });\n});\n\nrouter.post('/:id/vote', async (req, res) => {\n  try {\n    await db.query(\n      `INSERT INTO alert_votes (alert_id, user_id, vote) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)`,\n      [req.params.id, === '23505') return res.status(409).json({ error: 'Already voted' });\n    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });\n  }\n});\n\nmodule.exports = router;"

                "content": "import 'dart:convert';\nimport 'dart:io';\nimport 'package:flutter/material.dart';\nimport 'package:http/http.dart' as http;\nimport 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';\nimport 'api_service.dart';\n\nconst int appVersion = 2;\n\nclass UpdateService {\n  static Future<void> checkForUpdate(BuildContext context) async {\n    try {\n      final res = await http.get(Uri.parse('${ApiService.baseUrl.replaceAll('/api/v1', '')}/version'));\n      final data = jsonDecode(res.body);\n      final serverVersion = data['version'] as int;\n      final url = data['url'] as String;\n\n      if (serverVersion > appVersion && context.mounted) {\n        showDialog(\n          context: context,\n          barrierDismissible: false,\n          builder: (_) => _UpdateDialog(url: url),\n        );\n      }\n    } catch (_) {}\n  }\n}\n\nclass _UpdateDialog extends StatefulWidget {\n  final String url;\n  const _UpdateDialog({required this.url});\n  @override State<_UpdateDialog> createState() => _UpdateDialogState();\n}\n\nclass _UpdateDialogState extends State<_UpdateDialog> {\n  double _progress = 0;\n  bool _downloading = false;\n\n  Future<void> _download() async {\n    setState(() => _downloading = true);\n    try {\n      final req = http.Request('GET', Uri.parse(widget.url));\n      final res = await http.Client().send(req);\n      final total = res.contentLength ?? 0;\n      final dir = await getTemporaryDirectory();\n      final file = File('${dir.path}/AlertMap.apk');\n      final sink = file.openWrite();\n      int received = 0;\n\n      await for (final chunk in res.stream) {\n        sink.add(chunk);\n        received += chunk.length;\n        if (total > 0) setState(() => _progress = received / total);\n      }\n      await sink.close();\n\n      // Install APK via intent\n      await Process.run('am', ['start', '-a', 'android.intent.action.VIEW', '-t', 'application/vnd.android.package-archive', '-d', 'file://${file.path}']);\n    } catch (_) {\n      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context);\n    }\n  }\n\n  @override\n  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n    return AlertDialog(\n      title: const Text('Dostępna aktualizacja'),\n      content: _downloading\n          ? Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [\n              LinearProgressIndicator(value: _progress),\n              const SizedBox(height: 8),\n              Text('${(_progress * 100).toInt()}%'),\n            ])\n          : const Text('Nowa wersja AlertMap jest dostępna. Zaktualizuj teraz.'),\n      actions: [\n        if (!_downloading) TextButton(\n          onPressed: _download,\n          child: const Text('Aktualizuj'),\n        ),\n      ],\n    );\n  }\n}\n",

          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Gotowe. Teraz otwórz apkę na telefonie — powinien wyskoczyć dialog \"Dostępna aktualizacja\". Jeśli nie (bo wersja 2 nie miała jeszcze tego mechanizmu), pobierz ręcznie ostatni raz: **https://alert.u235.pl/download**\n\nMapa teraz używa **CartoDB Dark Matter** — ciemna, minimalistyczna, w pełni darmowa bez klucza API. Od następnej aktualizacji apka będzie się sama aktualizować."
          }
        ]
      }
    },

      "version": "v1",

        "content": [
          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "jest komunikat o aktualizacji, aktualizuje się do 100% i wisi"
          }
        ],
        "meta": {
          "timestamp": 1777557594
        }

    {
      "version": "v1",
      "kind": "AssistantMessage",
      "data": {
        "message_id": "7b68afab-baea-4c2a-b1c0-8c648f4d3248",
        "content": [
          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "\n\nProblem jest w instalacji APK — `Process.run('am', ...)` nie działa z Flutter. Muszę użyć natywnego intent przez `url_launcher` lub otworzyć plik przez content provider. Najprostsze rozwiązanie — po pobraniu otwieram URL w przeglądarce, co triggeruje instalację:"
          },
          {
            "kind": "toolUse",
            "data": {
              "toolUseId": "tooluse_cEx3AnoHDdZd2dsUwHXOPQ",
              "name": "write",
              "input": {
                "__tool_use_purpose": "Naprawiam update service — po pobraniu otwiera APK przez intent",
                "command": "create",
                "content": "import 'dart:convert';\nimport 'package:flutter/material.dart';\nimport 'package:flutter/services.dart';\nimport 'package:http/http.dart' as http;\nimport 'api_service.dart';\n\nconst int appVersion = 3;\n\nclass UpdateService {\n  static Future<void> checkForUpdate(BuildContext context) async {\n    try {\n      final res = await http.get(Uri.parse('${ApiService.baseUrl.replaceAll('/api/v1', '')}/version'));\n      final data = jsonDecode(res.body);\n      final serverVersion = data['version'] as int;\n      final url = data['url'] as String;\n\n      if (serverVersion > appVersion && context.mounted) {\n        showDialog(\n          context: context,\n          barrierDismissible: false,\n          builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(\n            title: const Text('Dostępna aktualizacja'),\n            content: const Text('Nowa wersja AlertMap jest dostępna. Pobierz i zainstaluj.'),\n            actions: [\n              TextButton(\n                onPressed: () {\n                  Navigator.pop(ctx);\n                  // Otwórz URL w przeglądarce — Android pobierze i zaproponuje instalację\n                  const platform = MethodChannel('pl.u235.alertmap/update');\n                  platform.invokeMethod('openUrl', url).catchError((_) {});\n                },\n                child: const Text('Aktualizuj'),\n              ),\n            ],\n          ),\n        );\n      }\n    } catch (_) {}\n  }\n}\n",
                "path": "/home/ooxo/alert/mobile/lib/services/update_service.dart"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    },

Pobierz i zainstaluj.'),\n            actions: [\n              TextButton(\n                onPressed: () {\n                  Navigator.pop(ctx);\n                  // Otwórz URL w przeglądarce — Android pobierze i zaproponuje instalację\n                  const platform = MethodChannel('pl.u235.alertmap/update');\n                  platform.invokeMethod('openUrl', url).catchError((_) {});\n                },\n                child: const Text('Aktualizuj'),\n              ),\n            ],\n          ),\n        );\n      }\n    } catch (_) {}\n  }\n}\n"

        "content": [
          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "trzeba dodać jeszcze opcje ustawień gdzie będzie można zmieniać ustawienia appki takie jak motyw ciemny/jasny/systemowy, zmiana maila, zmiana hasła i inne przydatne rzeczy. trzeba również zrobić lepiej system powiadomień (z opcją powiadomienia podobną do alertów cell broadcast). czy przebudowanie z flutter do natywnej appki da jakieś korzyści?"
          }
        ],
        "meta": {

    },
    {
      "version": "v1",
      "kind": "AssistantMessage",
      "data": {
        "message_id": "98ff7a4e-79c3-4394-9fb5-3fb66c5d0e76",
        "content": [
          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "\n\nDobre pytania. Zacznę od odpowiedzi na pytanie o natywną apkę, potem lecę z implementacją.\n\n## Flutter vs Natywna — czy warto przebudowywać?\n\n**Nie warto na tym etapie.** Oto dlaczego:\n\n| Aspekt | Flutter | Natywna (Kotlin + Swift) |\n|---|---|---|\n| Powiadomienia push | ✅ Pełne wsparcie (FCM, local notifications) | ✅ Tak samo |\n| Background location | ✅ Działa z pluginami | ⚡ Nieco lepsze battery management |\n| Cell broadcast style | ✅ Heads-up notifications (fullScreenIntent) | ✅ Tak samo — to ten sam Android API |\n| Wydajność mapy | ✅ Wystarczająca | ⚡ Minimalnie lepsza |\n| Czas developmentu | ⚡ 1 codebase | ❌ 2x roboty (Android + iOS osobno) |\n| Utrzymanie | ⚡ 1 codebase | ❌ 2x utrzymanie |\n\n**Cell broadcast style** to po prostu `heads-up notification` z `fullScreenIntent` i `PRIORITY_MAX` — działa identycznie z Flutter. Prawdziwy Cell Broadcast (jak alerty RCB) wymaga współpracy z operatorem telekomunikacyjnym i nie jest dostępny dla zwykłych apek.\n\nNatywna apka miałaby sens gdybyś potrzebował zaawansowanego background processingu lub custom UI na poziomie systemu. Na razie Flutter daje wszystko co potrzeba.\n\nLecę z implementacją:"
          },
          {

      "data": {
        "message_id": "17c4b2b5-9cbc-41d3-9e67-b133849bc62d",
        "content": [
          {
            "kind": "toolResult",
            "data": {
              "toolUseId": "tooluse_ttSdZ6Qy6eZe2Q5QT7dCyh",
              "content": [
                {
                  "kind": "text",
                  "data": "const router = require('express').Router();\nconst db = require('../config/db');\nconst auth = require('../middleware/auth');\n\nrouter.use(auth);\n\nrouter.get('/me', async (req, res) => {\n  const { rows } = await db.query(\n    `SELECT id, email, username, avatar_url, alert_radius_m, reputation_score, is_child, created_at FROM users WHERE id = $1`,\n    [req.user.id]\n  );\n  res.json(rows[0] || {});\n});\n\nrouter.patch('/me', async (req, res) => {\n  const allowed = ['username', 'alert_radius_m', 'avatar_url'];\n  const fields = Object.keys(req.body).filter((k) => allowed.includes(k));\n  if (!fields.length) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'No valid fields' });\n\n  const sets = fields.map((f, i) => `${f} = $${i + 2}`).join(', ');\n  const vals = fields.map((f) => req.body[f]);\n  const { rows } = await db.query(\n    `UPDATE users SET ${sets}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, email, username, alert_radius_m`,\n    [req.user.id, ...vals]\n  );\n  res.json(rows[0]);\n});\n\nrouter.put('/me/location', async (req, res) => {\n  const { lat, lng } = req.body;\n  await db.query(\n    `UPDATE users SET last_location = ST_MakePoint($2, $1)::geography, last_location_at = NOW() WHERE id = $3`,\n    [lat, lng, req.user.id]\n  );\n  const { rows } = await db.query(`SELECT * FROM find_alerts_nearby($1, $2, (SELECT alert_radius_m FROM users WHERE id = $3))`, [lat, lng, req.user.id]);\n  res.json({ nearby_alerts: rows });\n});\n\nrouter.put('/me/fcm-token', async (req, res) => {\n  await db.query(`UPDATE users SET fcm_token = $1 WHERE id = $2`, [req.body.fcm_token, req.user.id]);\n  res.json({ ok: true });\n});\n\nmodule.exports = router;"
                }
              ],
              "status": "success"
            }
          }
        ],

                    "Text": "const router = require('express').Router();\nconst db = require('../config/db');\nconst auth = require('../middleware/auth');\n\nrouter.use(auth);\n\nrouter.get('/me', async (req, res) => {\n  const { rows } = await db.query(\n    `SELECT id, email, username, avatar_url, alert_radius_m, reputation_score, is_child, created_at FROM users WHERE id = $1`,\n    [req.user.id]\n  );\n  res.json(rows[0] || {});\n});\n\nrouter.patch('/me', async (req, res) => {\n  const allowed = ['username', 'alert_radius_m', 'avatar_url'];\n  const fields = Object.keys(req.body).filter((k) => allowed.includes(k));\n  if (!fields.length) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'No valid fields' });\n\n  const sets = fields.map((f, i) => `${f} = $${i + 2}`).join(', ');\n  const vals = fields.map((f) => req.body[f]);\n  const { rows } = await db.query(\n    `UPDATE users SET ${sets}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, email, username, alert_radius_m`,\n    [req.user.id, ...vals]\n  );\n  res.json(rows[0]);\n});\n\nrouter.put('/me/location', async (req, res) => {\n  const { lat, lng } = req.body;\n  await db.query(\n    `UPDATE users SET last_location = ST_MakePoint($2, $1)::geography, last_location_at = NOW() WHERE id = $3`,\n    [lat, lng, req.user.id]\n  );\n  const { rows } = await db.query(`SELECT * FROM find_alerts_nearby($1, $2, (SELECT alert_radius_m FROM users WHERE id = $3))`, [lat, lng, req.user.id]);\n  res.json({ nearby_alerts: rows });\n});\n\nrouter.put('/me/fcm-token', async (req, res) => {\n  await db.query(`UPDATE users SET fcm_token = $1 WHERE id = $2`, [req.body.fcm_token, req.user.id]);\n  res.json({ ok: true });\n});\n\nmodule.exports = router;"
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },

              "content": [
                {
                  "kind": "text",
                  "data": "import 'package:flutter/material.dart';\nimport 'package:provider/provider.dart';\nimport 'providers/auth_provider.dart';\nimport 'providers/alert_provider.dart';\nimport 'services/api_service.dart';\nimport 'services/socket_service.dart';\nimport 'services/background_service.dart';\nimport 'services/update_service.dart';\nimport 'screens/auth/login_screen.dart';\nimport 'screens/map/map_screen.dart';\nimport 'screens/family/family_screen.dart';\nimport 'screens/family/family_group_screen.dart';\nimport 'screens/profile/profile_screen.dart';\n\nvoid main() {\n  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();\n  runApp(const AlertMapApp());\n}\n\nclass AlertMapApp extends StatelessWidget {\n  const AlertMapApp({super.key});\n\n  @override\n  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n    final api = ApiService();\n    final socket = SocketService();\n    final bg = BackgroundService(api, socket);\n\n    return MultiProvider(\n      providers: [\n        Provider.value(value: api),\n        Provider.value(value: socket),\n        Provider.value(value: bg),\n        ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => AuthProvider(api)..tryAutoLogin()),\n        ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => AlertProvider(api, socket)),\n      ],\n      child: MaterialApp(\n        title: 'AlertMap',\n        debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,\n        theme: ThemeData(colorSchemeSeed: Colors.red, useMaterial3: true),\n        home: const _AuthGate(),\n        onGenerateRoute: (settings) {\n          // Handle /family/:id route\n          final uri = Uri.parse(settings.name ?? '');\n          if (uri.pathSegments.length == 2 && uri.pathSegments[0] == 'family') {\n            return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => FamilyGroupScreen(\n              groupId: uri.pathSegments[1],\n              groupName: (settings.arguments as String?) ?? 'Grupa',\n            ));\n          }\n          // Static routes\n          return MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => switch (settings.name) {\n            '/map' => const MapScreen(),\n            '/family' => const FamilyScreen(),\n            '/profile' => const ProfileScreen(),\n            '/login' => const LoginScreen(),\n            _ => const MapScreen(),\n          });\n        },\n      ),\n    );\n  }\n}\n\nclass _AuthGate extends StatefulWidget {\n  const _AuthGate();\n  @override State<_AuthGate> createState() => _AuthGateState();\n}\n\nclass _AuthGateState extends State<_AuthGate> {\n  @override\n  void initState() {\n    super.initState();\n    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) => UpdateService.checkForUpdate(context));\n    // Start background services when logged in\n    final auth = context.read<AuthProvider>();\n    auth.addListener(() {\n      if (auth.isLoggedIn) {\n        final token = context.read<ApiService>().token;\n        if (token != null) {\n          context.read<BackgroundService>().init().then((_) {\n            context.read<BackgroundService>().startTracking(token);\n            context.read<AlertProvider>().connectSocket(token);\n          });\n        }\n      } else {\n        context.read<BackgroundService>().stopTracking();\n        context.read<AlertProvider>().disconnectSocket();\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  @override\n  Widget build(BuildContext context) {\n    final auth = context.watch<AuthProvider>();\n    return auth.isLoggedIn ? const MapScreen() : const LoginScreen();\n  }\n}"

                "__tool_use_purpose": "Ulepszam BackgroundService z kanałami i heads-up notifications",
                "command": "create",
                "content": "import 'dart:async';\nimport 'package:geolocator/geolocator.dart';\nimport 'package:flutter_local_notifications/flutter_local_notifications.dart';\nimport 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';\nimport 'api_service.dart';\nimport 'socket_service.dart';\n\nclass BackgroundService {\n  final ApiService _api;\n  final SocketService _socket;\n  final _notifications = FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin();\n  StreamSubscription<Position>? _locationSub;\n\n  BackgroundService(this._api, this._socket);\n\n  Future<void> init() async {\n    await _notifications.initialize(const InitializationSettings(\n      android: AndroidInitializationSettings('@mipmap/ic_launcher'),\n      iOS: DarwinInitializationSettings(),\n    ));\n\n    // Kanał: Alerty zagrożeń — cell broadcast style (max priority, fullscreen)\n    const alertChannel = AndroidNotificationChannel(\n      'danger_alerts',\n      'Alerty zagrożeń',\n      description: 'Powiadomienia o zagrożeniach w okolicy',\n      importance: Importance.max,\n      playSound: true,\n      enableVibration: true,\n      enableLights: true,\n    );\n\n    // Kanał: Alerty rodzinne\n    const familyChannel = AndroidNotificationChannel(\n      'family_alerts',\n      'Alerty rodzinne',\n      description: 'Geofence i lokalizacja rodziny',\n      importance: Importance.high,\n      playSound: true,\n      enableVibration: true,\n    );\n\n    final androidPlugin = _notifications.resolvePlatformSpecificImplementation<AndroidFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin>();\n    await androidPlugin?.createNotificationChannel(alertChannel);\n    await androidPlugin?.createNotificationChannel(familyChannel);\n  }\n\n  void startTracking(String token) {\n    _socket.connect(token,\n      onNewAlert: (data) async {\n        if (!await _prefEnabled('notif_alerts')) return;\n        _showDangerNotification(\n          '⚠️ ${data['category']?.toString().toUpperCase() ?? 'ZAGROŻENIE'}',\n          data['title'] ?? 'Nowe zagrożenie w okolicy',\n          data['description']?.toString(),\n        );\n      },\n      onGeofenceExit: (data) async {\n        if (!await _prefEnabled('notif_family')) return;\n        _showFamilyNotification(\n          '🚨 Dziecko opuściło bezpieczną strefę!',\n          '${data['username'] ?? 'Dziecko'} opuścił/a strefę \"${data['geofence_name'] ?? ''}\"',\n        );\n      },\n    );\n\n    _locationSub = Geolocator.getPositionStream(\n      locationSettings: const LocationSettings(accuracy: LocationAccuracy.high, distanceFilter: 50),\n    ).listen((pos) {\n      _socket.updateLocation(pos.latitude, pos.longitude);\n      _api.post('/users/me/location', {'lat': pos.latitude, 'lng': pos.longitude}).catchError((_) {});\n    });\n  }\n\n  void stopTracking() {\n    _locationSub?.cancel();\n    _socket.disconnect();\n  }\n\n  Future<bool> _prefEnabled(String key) async {\n    final p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();\n    return p.getBool(key) ?? true;\n  }\n\n  Future<bool> get _soundEnabled async => _prefEnabled('notif_sound');\n  Future<bool> get _vibrationEnabled async => _prefEnabled('notif_vibration');\n\n  /// Cell broadcast style — fullscreen intent, max priority\n  Future<void> _showDangerNotification(String title, String body, [String? bigText]) async {\n    final sound = await _soundEnabled;\n    final vibration = await _vibrationEnabled;\n\n    await _notifications.show(\n      DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch ~/ 1000,\n      title,\n      body,\n      NotificationDetails(\n        android: AndroidNotificationDetails(\n          'danger_alerts', 'Alerty zagrożeń',\n          importance: Importance.max,\n          priority: Priority.max,\n          fullScreenIntent: true,  // Cell broadcast style — wyświetla na pełnym ekranie\n          category: AndroidNotificationCategory.alarm,\n          visibility: NotificationVisibility.public,\n          playSound: sound,\n          enableVibration: vibration,\n          styleInformation: bigText != null ? BigTextStyleInformation(bigText, contentTitle: title) : null,\n          ticker: title,\n          autoCancel: true,\n          ongoing: false,\n          colorized: true,\n          color: const Color(0xFFFF1744),\n        ),\n        iOS: const DarwinNotificationDetails(\n          presentAlert: true,\n          presentSound: true,\n          interruptionLevel: InterruptionLevel.critical,\n        ),\n      ),\n    );\n  }\n\n  Future<void> _showFamilyNotification(String title, String body) async {\n    final sound = await _soundEnabled;\n    final vibration = await _vibrationEnabled;\n\n    await _notifications.show(\n      DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch ~/ 1000,\n      title,\n      body,\n      NotificationDetails(\n        android: AndroidNotificationDetails(\n          'family_alerts', 'Alerty rodzinne',\n          importance: Importance.high,\n          priority: Priority.high,\n          fullScreenIntent: true,\n          category: AndroidNotificationCategory.alarm,\n          playSound: sound,\n          enableVibration: vibration,\n          colorized: true,\n          color: const Color(0xFFFF6D00),\n        ),\n        iOS: const DarwinNotificationDetails(presentAlert: true, presentSound: true),\n      ),\n    );\n  }\n}\n\nclass Color {\n  final int value;\n  const Color(this.value);\n}\n",

            "data": {
              "toolUseId": "tooluse_fDZ88wDRYRxmY79I6WNGT0",
              "content": [
                {
                  "kind": "text",
                  "data": "import 'dart:convert';\nimport 'package:http/http.dart' as http;\nimport 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';\n\nclass ApiService {\n  static const baseUrl = 'https://alert.u235.pl/api/v1';\n  String? _token;\n\n  Future<void> loadToken() async {\n    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();\n    _token = prefs.getString('jwt_token');\n  }\n\n  Map<String, String> get _headers => {\n    'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n    if (_token != null) 'Authorization': 'Bearer $_token',\n  };\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> post(String path, Map<String, dynamic> body) async {\n    final res = await http.post(Uri.parse('$baseUrl$path'), headers: _headers, body: jsonEncode(body));\n    return jsonDecode(res.body);\n  }\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> get(String path, [Map<String, String>? params]) async {\n    final uri = Uri.parse('$baseUrl$path').replace(queryParameters: params);\n    final res = await http.get(uri, headers: _headers);\n    return jsonDecode(res.body);\n  }\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> patch(String path, Map<String, dynamic> body) async {\n    final res = await http.patch(Uri.parse('$baseUrl$path'), headers: _headers, body: jsonEncode(body));\n    return jsonDecode(res.body);\n  }\n\n  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> delete(String path) async {\n    final res = await http.delete(Uri.parse('$baseUrl$path'), headers: _headers);\n    return jsonDecode(res.body);\n  }\n\n  Future<void> setToken(String token) async {\n    _token = token;\n    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();\n    await prefs.setString('jwt_token', token);\n  }\n\n  Future<void> clearToken() async {\n    _token = null;\n    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();\n    await prefs.remove('jwt_token');\n  }\n\n  String? get token => _token;\n}"
                }
              ],
              "status": "success"
            }
          }
        ],

        "content": [
          {
            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Gotowe, wersja 5 na serwerze. Otwórz apkę — powinien wyskoczyć dialog aktualizacji.\n\n**Co nowego:**\n\n**Ustawienia** (Profil → Ustawienia):\n- **Motyw** — ciemny / jasny / systemowy (z persystencją)\n- **Powiadomienia** — toggle dla alertów zagrożeń, alertów rodzinnych, dźwięku, wibracji\n- **Zmiana email** — wymaga potwierdzenia hasłem\n- **Zmiana hasła** — wymaga starego hasła, min 6 znaków\n- **Zmiana nazwy użytkownika**\n- **Usunięcie konta** — kaskadowe usunięcie wszystkich danych, wymaga hasła\n\n**Powiadomienia cell broadcast style:**\n- 2 kanały: `danger_alerts` (max priority) i `family_alerts` (high priority)\n- `fullScreenIntent: true` — powiadomienie wyświetla się na pełnym ekranie nawet przy zablokowanym telefonie (jak alert RCB)\n- `category: alarm` — system traktuje to jako alarm\n- Respektuje ustawienia dźwięku/wibracji z ekranu ustawień"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
